rubric.why: Checks the trend in ionization energy across a period.
rubric.description: Ionization energy generally increases from left to right across a period.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for stating that ionization energy increases across a period.

rubric.why: Checks the trend in ionization energy down a group.
rubric.description: Ionization energy generally decreases from top to bottom down a group.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for stating that ionization energy decreases down a group.

modelAnswer: Ionization energy generally increases from left to right across a period.
It generally decreases from top to bottom down a group.
